chunks: The eminent Shaykh Abu Jafar Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babawayh (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father and Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid and Jafar b. Muhammad b. Masrur (may Allah be pleased with them) narrated to us. They said: al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. Amer narrated to us from his uncle Abdullah b. Amer from Muhammad b. Abi Umayr from Marazim b. Hakim from Abi Basir.

He said: Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (upon him be peace) said to a man from his companions: Shall I not inform you of the reason why Salman and Abu Dharr embraced Islam? So, the man said — and he erred: As for the Islam of Salman, I know it, so inform me of the reason why Abu Dharr embraced Islam. So Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq said: Surely, Abu Dharr was in Batn Marr herding his sheep when a wolf came to the right of his sheep. So Abu Dharr drove it away with his staff. Then the wolf came to the left of his sheep. So Abu Dharr drove it away with his staff. Then he said to it: By Allah, I have not seen a wolf more wretched than you nor eviller. So the wolf said: Eviller — by Allah — than me are the people of Mecca. Allah sent them a prophet yet they belied him and insulted him. The words of the wolf reached the ears of Abu Dharr. He said to his sister: Bring me my feeding bowl and my vessel and my staff. Then he ran until he entered Mecca. He found a circle of people gathered, so he sat among them. They were insulting the Prophet and abusing him just as the wolf had said. So Abu Dharr said: This, by Allah, is what the wolf informed me of. They continued in this state until the day ended and Abu Talib came. Some of them said to others: Stop, for his uncle has come. When he came close, they honored and revered him. Abu Talib did not cease being their speaker and orator until they dispersed. When Abu Talib stood up, I followed him. He turned to me and said: What do you need? I said: This is the prophet raised among you. He said: What do you need from him? So Abu Dharr said to him: I believe in him and accept him, and he will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him. So Abu Talib said: Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah? He said: So I said: Yes, I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. He said: Tomorrow at this hour, come to me. The next morning Abu Dharr came. The circle was gathered and they were abusing the Prophet and insulting him just as the wolf had said. He sat with them until Abu Talib came. Some of them said to others: Stop, for his uncle has come. So they stopped. Abu Talib came and sat. He did not cease being their speaker and orator until he stood. When he stood, Abu Dharr followed him. Abu Talib turned to him and said: What do you need? He said: This is the prophet raised among you. He said: What do you need from him? He said: I believe in him and accept him, and he will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him. So Abu Talib said: Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah? He said: Yes, I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. He said: So he took me to a house within which was Jafar b. Abi Talib. When I entered, I delivered the salaam and he returned it. Then he said: What do you need? So I said: This is the prophet raised among you. He said: What do you need from him? I said: I believe in him and accept him, and he will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him. He said: Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah? I said: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. So he took me to a house within which was Hamza b. Abd al-Muttalib. When I entered, I delivered the salaam and he returned it. Then he said: What do you need? So I said: This is the prophet raised among you. He said: What do you need from him? I said: I believe in him and accept him, and he will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him. He said: Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah? I said: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. He said: So he took me to a house within which was Ali b. Abi Talib (upon him be peace). When I entered, I delivered the salaam and he returned it. Then he said: What do you need? I said: This is the prophet raised among you. He said: What do you need from him? I said: I believe in him and accept him, and he will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him. He said: Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah? So I said: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. He said: So he took me to a house within which was the Messenger of Allah, and behold he was light upon light. When I entered, I delivered the salaam and he returned it. Then he said: What do you need? I said: This is the prophet raised among you. He said: What do you need from him? So I said: I believe in him and accept him, and he will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him. He said: Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah, alone without partner, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah? I said: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, alone without partner, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. So he said: I am the Messenger of Allah. O Aba Dharr, go to your land, for you will find that a cousin of yours has died. Take his wealth and stay there until my Order becomes public. Abu Dharr said: So I went to my land and I found that a cousin of mine had died and left behind much wealth at the time that the Messenger of Allah had informed me of. I held onto his wealth and remained in my land until the Order of the Messenger of Allah became public, then I went to him.

key_terms.الذئب: The wolf — miraculously speaks to Abu Dharr about the Prophet
key_terms.بطن مر: Batn Marr — a valley near Mecca
key_terms.نور على نور: Light upon light — describing the Prophet's radiance

ai.seo_question: How did Abu Dharr al-Ghifari come to embrace Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq narrates the story of Abu Dharr al-Ghifari's conversion to Islam. While herding sheep, a wolf spoke to Abu Dharr, telling him that the people of Mecca were worse than it because they rejected a prophet sent by God. Abu Dharr traveled to Mecca, where Abu Talib guided him through Jafar, Hamza, and Ali until he finally met the Prophet Muhammad, who confirmed his prophethood and instructed Abu Dharr to return home until his mission became public.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father and Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid and Ja`far b Muhammad b. Masrur (ra) narrated to us. They said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from his uncle `Abdullah b. `Amer from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Marazim b. Hakim from Abi Basir.

He said: Abu `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) said to a man from his companions: Shall I not inform you of the reason why Salman and Abu Dharr (rh) embraced Islam? So, the man said – and he made a mistake: As for the Islam of Salman, I know it, so inform me why Abu Dharr came to Islam. So, Abu `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) said: Surely, Aba Dharr (rh) was in the middle of Murr (a juncture near Mecca) herding his sheep when a wolf came to the right of his sheep. So, Abu Dharr scared it away with his staff. Then, the wolf came to the left of his sheep. So, Abu Dharr scared it away with his staff. Then, Abu Dharr said to it: “By Allah, I have not seen a wolf that is more wretched and eviller than you.” So, the wolf said: “By Allah, the people of Mecca are eviller than me, for Allah sent them a prophet, yet they belied him and insulted him.” The words went to the ears of Abi Dharr, so he said to his sister: “Take my feeding bowl, my vessel, and my staff.” Then, he ran until he reached Mecca. He found a circle [of people] gathered, so he sat among them. They were insulting and abusing the Prophet (s), just as the wolf had said. So, Abu Dharr said: “This, by Allah, is what the wolf had informed me.” They continued doing this until the day had ended and Abu Talib proceeded. One of them said to the other: “Stop, for his uncle has come.” When he came closer to them, they honoured him. Abu Talib did not stop speaking to them until they dispersed. When Abu Talib stood, I followed him. Then, he turned to me and said: “What do you need?” So, I said: “This prophet has been raised among you.” He said: “What do you need from him?” So, Abu Dharr said to him: “I want to believe in him and accept him. He will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him.” So, Abu Talib said: “Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?” He said: I said: “Yes. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.” Then, he said: “Tomorrow morning at such-and-such hour, come to me.” He said: The next morning, Abu Dharr came. He found the circle gathered, and he found them insulting and abusing the Prophet (s), just as the wolf had said. He sat with them until Abu Talib proceeded. One of them said to the other: “Stop, for his uncle has come.” So, they stopped, and Abu Talib came and sat down. He did not stop speaking to them until he stood. When he stood, Abu Dharr followed him. Then, Abu Talib turned to him and said: “What do you need?” So, he said: “This prophet that was raised among you.” He said: “What do you need from him?” He said: He said to him: “I want to believe in him and accept him. He will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him.” So, Abu Talib said: “Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?” He said: I said: “Yes. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.” So, he took me to a house, within which was Ja`far b. Abi Talib. He said: When I entered, I delivered the salaam, and he returned the salaam. Then, he said: “What do you need?” He said: So, I said: “This prophet that was raised among you.” He said: “What do you need from him?” I said: “I want to believe in him and accept him. He will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him.” He said: “Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?” I said: “I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.” So, he took me to a house, within which was Hamza b. `Abd al-Muttalib. Then, he said: “What do you need?” So, I said: “This prophet that was raised among you.” He said: “What do you need from him?” I said: “I want to believe in him and accept him. He will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him.” He said: “Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?” I said: “I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.” He said: So, he took me to a house, within which was `Ali b. Abi Talib. When I entered, I delivered the salaam, and he returned the salaam. Then, he said: “What do you need?” So, I said: “This prophet that was raised among you.” He said: “What do you need from him?” I said: “I want to believe in him and accept him. He will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him.” He said: “Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?” I said: “I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.”  He said: So, he took me to a house, within which was the Messenger of Allah (s). I found him to be light upon light. When I entered, I delivered the salaam, and he returned the salaam. Then, he said: “What do you need?” He said: So, I said: “This prophet that was raised among you.” He said: “What do you need from him?” I said: “I want to believe in him and accept him. He will not command me to do a thing except that I will obey him.” He said: “Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah, one without partners, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?” I said: “I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, one without partners, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.” So, he (s) said: “I am the Messenger of Allah. O Aba Dharr! Go to your city, for you will find that you have a cousin that has died. Take his wealth [as inheritance] and stay with it until my Order becomes public.” Abu Dharr said: I went to my city, and I found that my cousin had died. He left much wealth behind at that time that the Messenger of Allah (s) had informed me of. I held onto his wealth cautiously and I remained in my city until the Order of the Messenger of Allah (s) became public. Then, I went to him.
